name: ORION Corp.
summary: ORION Corp. operates internationally as a confectionery company, boasting a diverse product portfolio that includes a wide array of sweet treats such as pies, snacks, biscuits, candies, jellies, gums, and chocolates, frequently marketed under the Orion Power brand. The company also provides healthier options like whole wheat biscuits, bars, and beverages through its Dr.You line, alongside gourmet items such as brownies, crackers, cheese chips, and various chocolate products under the Market O brand. Specialized desserts are available under the Chocopie House brand, and ORION also distributes mineral water sourced from Jeju yongamsoo. Beyond its food endeavors, the corporation holds interests in film production and distribution and is the owner of a professional basketball team. Established in Seoul, South Korea, in 1956, the company was initially known as Tongyang Confectionery Corporation before officially changing its name to Orion Corporation in 2003.
